@@U00505@@
And even if he hadn’t come to terms with the devil, he'd still know defeat in the end.

@@U00507@@
(Entering.)

@@U00508@@
Excuse me, sir, I’m new here, just barely arrived—and, well, longed to make the acquaintance of a man the world respects and honors.

@@U00510@@
Your courtesy flatters me. Thank you. And yet, I’m a man like many another. Have you called on any of my colleagues?

@@U00512@@
Please, sir, take me under your wing. I come with the best of intentions, a fair amount of money, and a healthy body. My mother— well, she almost didn’t let me leave— but I’m eager to learn, it’s why I’m here.

@@U00514@@
Then I'd say you've come to the right place.

@@U00516@@
To be honest, sir, I wish I could escape right now. It’s so cramped. These walls, these halls, they intimidate me. It’s so bleak—no green, no trees, no grass. And the lecture halls, the benches! I can’t hear or see or think!

@@U00518@@
Yes, well, that comes with practice. The child at first is hesitant at the mother’s breast, but soon it feeds with gusto; and so with you. You'll find as you suck daily at Wisdom’s breasts,
translation:
@@U00505@@
即使他不向魔鬼妥协，他最终也还是会失败。

@@U00507@@
（进入。）

@@U00508@@
对不起，先生，我是新来的，刚刚抵达——而且，好吧，我渴望结识一个受到世界尊重和尊敬的人。

@@U00510@@
你的礼貌使我受宠若惊。谢谢。然而，我和其他许多人一样都是一个人。你拜访过我的同事吗？

@@U00512@@
先生，请将我置于您的羽翼之下。我怀着最美好的愿望、大量的金钱和健康的身体而来。我的母亲——好吧，她差点不让我离开——但我渴望学习，这就是我来这里的原因。

@@U00514@@
那么我想说你来对地方了。

@@U00516@@
说实话，先生，我希望我现在就能逃脱。太拥挤了。这些墙壁，这些大厅，它们让我感到害怕。真是荒凉——没有绿色，没有树，没有草。还有演讲厅、长凳！我听不到、看不到、也无法思考！

@@U00518@@
是的，嗯，这需要练习。孩子一开始对母亲的乳房有些犹豫，但很快就津津有味地吃了起来。你也是如此。当你每天吮吸智慧的乳房时，你会发现，
